sonnet.problem: The right answer, 'Because of his fear of God', was already put in front of the baker in stop 2 card 2. That question says Nehemiah tells the nobles and officials to 'walk in the fear of God'. This tips the answer to the later 'Why not?' question.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card asks what the robe shake 'means' and gives the answer as a plain statement ('God shaking out every promise breaker'). The text gives Nehemiah's words as a wish or prayer: 'May God likewise shake out of his house and possessions every man who does not keep this promise.' The card does not call it what the text calls it.
sonnet.rule: Call things what the text calls them.
